rows.commentary: 0.3: Jai Moondra slides one full and wide, inviting Louren Steenkamp to drive fiercely through cover-point for the opening boundary of the innings.
0.4: Jai Moondra attacks the channel on a length, and Louren Steenkamp cushions it quietly toward point with pillow-soft hands.
0.5: Jai Moondra digs it in short around off, where Louren Steenkamp meets it securely from the crease.
0.6: Jai Moondra hits a pristine good length, prompting Louren Steenkamp to simply tap it into the off-side.
1.1: Liam McCarthy drops it short of a length outside off, allowing Malan Kruger to steer it straight to point.
1.2: Liam McCarthy drops it short and wide outside off, and Malan Kruger throws his hands through the line, violently slashing it over point to open his account with a boundary.
1.3: Liam McCarthy targets the off stump with a touch of extra shortness, nudged softly into the off-side by Malan Kruger.
1.4: Liam McCarthy tests the shorter boundary line, guided down to third man by Malan Kruger for a comfortable single.
1.5: Liam McCarthy delivers a standard length ball that Louren Steenkamp reliably punches toward the point fielder.
1.6: Liam McCarthy pitches it up and shapes it away, leaving Louren Steenkamp to watch it pass with raised arms.
2.1: Jai Moondra lands a fuller delivery that tails inward, firmly blocked toward mid-on by Malan Kruger.
2.2: Jai Moondra floats a wide half-volley outside off, correctly judged and left completely alone by Malan Kruger.
2.3: Jai Moondra drops it back of a length down leg, Malan Kruger tries to glance but only finds a faint brush off the trousers into the keeper's gloves.
2.4: Jai Moondra serves it overpitched, and Malan Kruger launches a magnificent straight drive screaming past the umpire to the rope.
2.5: Jai Moondra targets outside off on a back of a length, allowing Malan Kruger to gently steer it through backward point for a single.
2.6: Jai Moondra curves a fuller delivery into the body, and Louren Steenkamp whips it uppishly past mid-wicket to finish the over in style.
3.1: Liam McCarthy gets challenged as Malan Kruger forces the ball straight back down the surface.
3.2: Liam McCarthy sees Malan Kruger guide the delivery down toward square third man to pick up a comfortable run.
3.3: Liam McCarthy digs it in short outside off, prompting Louren Steenkamp to gracefully sway out of the line of fire.
3.4: Liam McCarthy pitches it up, met by the full face of Louren Steenkamp's bat as he pushes it straight to mid-on.
31.2: Andy McBrine tests Jan Frylinck who creates room only to mistime his drive directly to mid-off.
31.3: Andy McBrine keeps it on a length, met solidly and kept out by Jan Frylinck.
31.4: Andy McBrine offers a full delivery on off, which Jan Frylinck drives firmly on the up towards mid-off.
31.5: Andy McBrine drifts this one short and wide, prompting an easy leave from Jan Frylinck as the umpire signals wide.
31.5: Andy McBrine flights it up, allowing Jan Frylinck to ease the ball toward extra cover and scamper through for a single.
31.6: Andy McBrine drops short around off, and Gerhard Erasmus brutally cuts against the spin past a scrambling sweeper cover for four.
32.1: Gavin Hoey angles it back of a length outside off, and Jan Frylinck deftly chops it toward cover-point.
32.2: Gavin Hoey fires in a shorter slider on off, chopped away past a diving backward point for a quick single by Gerhard Erasmus.
32.3: Gavin Hoey serves a short delivery around off, which Jan Frylinck knocks down comfortably to long-off.
32.4: Gavin Hoey floats it full around off, and Gerhard Erasmus drops to one knee to unleash a commanding slog-sweep through mid-wicket for four.

32.5: Gavin Hoey drops it into the middle-and-leg channel, and Gerhard Erasmus clears his front leg with devastating intent, launching the in-drifter flat over cow corner to bring up a majestic fifty in pure style.
32.6: Gavin Hoey strikes as Gerhard Erasmus holes out to George Dockrell at deep mid-wicket for 54, miscuing a dragdown straight into safe hands.
33.1: Andy McBrine tests Jan Frylinck, who pushes to mid-wicket and scrambles for a panicked single that nearly strands Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton short.
33.2: Andy McBrine drifts one well outside off, allowing Jan Frylinck to chop it away cleanly to sweeper cover for a single.
33.3: Dot ball from Andy McBrine to Loftie-Eaton.
33.4: Dot ball from Andy McBrine to Loftie-Eaton.
33.5: Andy McBrine slides it through to Loftie-Eaton, who works the ball away into the square leg region to pick up a single.
33.6: Andy McBrine finishes the over as Jan Frylinck steers a single out towards sweeper cover.
1.1: Smit lands one on a length around off, pushed firmly towards mid-off by Andrew Balbirnie.
1.2: Smit pitches it up around off, allowing Andrew Balbirnie to drive towards wide mid-off for a single.
1.3: Smit drops onto a length around middle and leg, clipped smoothly through square leg by Lorcan Tucker for a couple.
1.4: Lorcan Tucker dances down the track to flick through mid-wicket, rescued by a brilliant sliding boundary save that limits it to three.
1.5: Smit targets outside off on a length, squeezed neatly into the off-side.
1.6: Smit bowls on a length outside off, steered smoothly into the off-side by Andrew Balbirnie.
2.1: Bernard Scholtz tosses one up around off, pushed away into the off-side by Lorcan Tucker.
2.2: Bernard Scholtz fires it flatter on middle and leg, worked through the on-side for a single.
2.3: Bernard Scholtz slides one slightly short outside off, sliced off the back foot toward point by Andrew Balbirnie.
2.4: Bernard Scholtz pushes it fuller through the air, nudged through square leg for a single.
2.5: Bernard Scholtz lands a touch fuller on off, patted straight to extra cover by Lorcan Tucker.
2.6: Bernard Scholtz finds the same spot, driven straight to the identical fielder on the off-side.
3.1: Smit drops it on a good length around middle and leg, allowing Balbirnie to nudge it through backward square leg for a single.
3.2: Smit lands it in the channel, and Lorcan Tucker guides it down to third man to rotate the strike.
3.3: Smit offers width on a length outside off, which Andrew Balbirnie promptly knocks into the off-side.
3.4: Smit pitches it up around off, and Andrew Balbirnie drills it straight down the ground in a gorgeous stroke for four.
3.5: Smit drops it back of a length outside the off-stump, and Balbirnie guides it crisply towards cover-point for a dot.
3.6: Smit holds a tight length outside off, and Andrew Balbirnie defends it firmly into the off-side.
4.1: Bernard Scholtz tosses it up, and Lorcan Tucker pushes it down towards long-off for an easy single.
4.2: No run for Balbirnie off Bernard Scholtz.
15.1: Jack Brassell bowls a low full toss to Curtis Campher, who nudges it off the bottom end towards mid‑on for a single.
15.2: Jack Brassell delivers to Andy McBrine, who steers a wide ball outside off to third man for a single.
15.3: Jack Brassell sends a length around middle‑leg to Curtis Campher, who clips it through square leg for a single.
15.4: Jack Brassell bowls a full, straight ball to Andy McBrine, who drives it straight past the bowler for a four; the mid‑on fielder chases but cannot stop it.
15.5: Jack Brassell bowls a length around middle‑leg to Andy McBrine, who nudges it towards mid‑wicket for no run.
15.6: Jack Brassell delivers a short‑of‑length ball to Andy McBrine, who knocks it towards mid‑off for no run.
16.1: Loftie‑Eaton bowls a shorter‑side ball to Curtis Campher, who pulls it over mid‑wicket for two runs, barely clearing the fielder inside the circle.
16.2: Loftie‑Eaton sends a ball to Curtis Campher, who drives it towards cover for a single.
16.3: Loftie‑Eaton bowls a low ball to Andy McBrine, who keeps it close and bunts it back to the bowler for no run.
16.4: Loftie‑Eaton delivers to Andy McBrine, who knocks it to long‑on for a single.
16.5: Loftie‑Eaton bowls a ball to Curtis Campher, who transfers his weight onto the back foot and pulls it towards deep mid‑wicket for two runs.
16.6: Loftie‑Eaton bowls a tossed‑up delivery around off to Curtis Campher, who pushes it to cover for no run.
17.1: Erasmus bowls a tossed‑up delivery to McBrine, who clips it to mid‑wicket for no run.
17.2: Erasmus keeps low, McBrine attacks at the stumps, knocking it down the pitch for no run.
17.3: Erasmus delivers a full, wide outside off, and McBrine squares it for a single.
17.4: Erasmus bowls short and wide outside off to Campher, who cuts it past the point fielder for a single.
17.5: Erasmus offers width again to McBrine, who fails to score.
17.6: Erasmus bowls to long‑off, and McBrine takes a single.
31.2: Erasmus offers width outside off, inviting Campher to stroke a clean drive straight through the cover region for a single.
31.3: Erasmus drifts one down leg, rapping against Dockrell's pads and scampering away toward fine leg for a pair of leg byes.
31.4: Dockrell tickles a full, pad-bound delivery to wide mid-on, where a fumbling fielder gifts an extra run.
31.5: Campher pounces on a half-volley outside off, creaming a drive through extra cover as long-off's desperate chase ends in despair.
31.6: Going round the wicket with a short delivery, Erasmus watches Campher rock back and slice a cut past backward point for consecutive boundaries.
32.1: Scholtz watches Dockrell punch firmly to mid-wicket, where a slight fumble fails to yield a run.
32.2: Dockrell lofts a full delivery toward long-off, where Smit plunges forward to take a spectacular diving chance that spills agonizingly from his grasp.
32.3: Scholtz hits a stump-to-length line, watching Campher tuck it securely into the leg side.
32.4: Scholtz fires a shorter delivery outside off, steered smoothly by Campher straight to backward point.
32.5: Bernard Scholtz drops it full on off, choking Curtis Campher for room as he pushes it straight back down the pitch.
32.6: Bernard Scholtz probes that nagging off-stump channel again, inducing a drive left of his own boots where he snatches it to cap off a masterclass of an over.
33.1: Ruben Trumpelmann hits a length on off, meeting a dead-bat defensive push from George Dockrell toward cover-point.

33.2: Ruben Trumpelmann tests George Dockrell with a shortish ball off which a mistimed flat-batted stroke clears mid-on, prompting a searing sprint and boundary slide from the Namibian skipper Erasmus to save two.
33.3: Ruben Trumpelmann drops it on a length on off, guiding George Dockrell to guide it down toward a squarish third man.
33.4: Ruben Trumpelmann hurries Curtis Campher with a skiddy back of a length delivery outside off that flashes past the flailing blade.
33.5: Ruben Trumpelmann goes shortish outside off, allowing Curtis Campher to slap it firmly out to deep point.
33.6: Ruben Trumpelmann angles a full delivery into middle and leg, tickled away by George Dockrell toward deep mid-wicket to retain the strike.
34.1: Bernard Scholtz slides the arm delivery back of a length into middle and leg, tickled neatly around the corner by George Dockrell.
34.2: Bernard Scholtz watches Curtis Campher cleverly clear his leg and expose the stumps before dispatching the ball away.
34.3: Bernard Scholtz absorbs a gentle nudge from Curtis Campher sent out toward extra cover.
